Treten Widersprüche auf, können diese im Rahmen gemeinsamer Erörterungen korrigiert werden. Das Verhandlungsges präch bietet darüber hinaus den Bietern die Gelegenheit, Fragen zur Leistungserbringung zu stel len. Ebenso wird der Auftraggeber die Gelegenheit nutzen, Fragen zum Angebot zu stellen. Nach Abschluss der Verhandlungen werden die Bieter, mit denen Verhandlungen geführt wurden und deren Angebote eine Chance auf Zuschlagserteilu ng haben, mit Angabe einer letzten Einreichungsfrist („Last Call“) zur Abgabe eines fi nalen Angebotes („Best and Final Offer“ – BAFO) aufgerufen, welches das die Grundlage der Zuschlagserteilung bildet. Grundsätzlich bewahrt der Brandenburgische IT-Dienstleister Verschwiegenheit über die ihr bei ihrer Aufgabenwahrnehmung bekannt gewordenen dienstlichen Angelegenheiten. Im Zusammenhang mit der Vergabe „12908 Kommunikationslösung für 25.000 Personen im Bildungsbereich (Lehrermail) “ verarbeitet der Brandenburgische IT-Dienstleister Daten von Ihnen. Mit diesen Datenschutzhinweisen möchte der Brandenburgische IT-Dienstleister Sie nachstehend gemäß Artikel 13 DSGVO über die Verarbeitung Ihrer Daten informieren. It will draw them in and build on the knowledge and skill acquired in each stage. Programme Aim The purpose of this training programme is to design, develop and deliver a training programme that build people’s understanding of self-harm and the role it plays in the life of a person who self-harms. The programme will build the knowledge and confidence of the learner to have a conversation if they are concerned that someone may be self-harming. The training programme should provide people who access it with a sense of hope and reassurance that people can build healthier coping mechanisms. The Sizing Technology Pilot is a direct extension of this modernization mandate, seeking to apply advanced digital, computer vision, and AI-driven measurement extraction capabilities to a fundamental logistical process: Soldier and Cadet outfitting. The Army is exploring a Sizing Technology Pilot to modernize the Soldier and Cadet outfitting process by using body scanning, foot scanning, computer vision, and/or AI- driven measurement extraction to generate accurate measurements and translate them into recommended uniform and footwear sizing. This capability is intended to support personnel earlier in the accessions pipeline than is possible today, in support of a faster, more consistent, and more accurate issue experience. The scope of this requirement encompasses both body and foot scanning to modernize the issuance of both uniforms and footwear. The scope covers four primary initial accession pipelines: (1) Initial Entry Training (IET) Soldiers processing through Military Entrance Processing Stations (MEPS); (2) United States Military Academy (West Point) Cadets; (3) contracted Senior Reserve Officers' Training Co

forms_signatures.text: ment of the Army (HQDA) G-4 Logistics Initiatives Group is the directorate responsible for leading the Army’s digital transformation in logistics and Installation, Energy, and Environment (IE&E). The G-4 drives policy, governance, investment strategy, and the technical integration of logistics automated information management systems. Their strategic focus centers on logistics modernization through integrated information systems, scaling artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) analytics, and improving supply chain reliability across Army operations. The Sizing Technology Pilot is a direct extension of this modernization mandate, seeking to apply advanced digital, computer vision, and AI-driven measurement extraction capabilities to a fundamental logistical process: Soldier and Cadet outfitting. The Army is exploring a Sizing Technology Pilot to modernize the Soldier and Cadet outfitting process by using body scanning, foot scanning, computer vision, and/or AI- driven measurement extraction to generate accurate measurements and translate them into recommended uniform and footwear sizing. This capability is intended to support personnel earlier in the accessions pipeline than is possible today, in support of a faster, more consistent, and more accurate iss

l, non- contact methods and translating those measurements into recommended standard Army uniform and footwear sizes. Accurate measurement-to-size mapping — not a 3D visual try-on or avatar rendering, is the core capability sought. The Army is seeking a solution that will operate reliably across a wide spectrum of Army operating environments, minimize the training burden on Soldiers and administering staff, and be capable of integrating with designated Army data systems to support downstream sizing and issue processes. 3. REQUIRED AND DESIRED SOLUTION ATTRIBUTES. Required Attributes: The proposed solution shall meet the following mandatory requirements: • Comprehensive Scanning and Environmental Resilience: Must capture both body and foot measurements sufficient to determine standard Army uniform and footwear sizing using automated, digital, non-contact methods that eliminate manual measurements. The capture hardware must be transportable and capable of operating reliably across a wide spectrum of environments, including indoor facilities and austere outdoor settings, accommodating real-world conditions such as variable ambient lighting and physical space constraints. • Data Translation & Mapping: Must translate captured body and foot measurements into recommen

tive, requiring minimal training for both the Soldiers and Cadets being measured and the administering staff. • Security & Compliance: Must comply with all applicable DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements and be capable of obtaining the appropriate Authorization to Operate (ATO) prior to processing any Soldier and Cadet data (all captured data must be encrypted at rest and in transit). Impact Level 5 (IL5) is required prior to full-scale enterprise deployment. Pilot execution will be conducted in an isolated, test/dummy network environment. • Data Management & Privacy: Must support a defined data retention and deletion schedule that strictly adheres to Army records-management and Privacy Act requirements. • Inclusive Accuracy: Must produce accurate measurements across the complete spectrum of body types, statures, and physical compositions represented in the Army accession and training population. • Accessibility (Section 508): Must provide an accessible alternative process for Soldiers and Cadets who are unable to use, or elect not to use, the scanning solution; any user-facing digital interface must strictly comply with Section 508 accessibility standards. • Data Ownership & Licensing: Must allow the Government to retain exclusive ownership of all Soldier and Cadet sizing data as well as any vendor-generated technical or derived data. • Hardware Agility & Openness: The proposed solution must be hardware-

insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

sla_onsite.text: llija olemasolevast IT-arhitektuurist ning Microsofti tehnoloogiate (sh Microsoft 365 keskkonna) laialdasest kasutusest, on oluline, et hangitav tarkvara oleks nendega tehniliselt ja funktsionaalselt tihedalt integreeritav. 1.2.1.4 Hangitav tarkvara peab põhinema Microsoft Dynamics 365 platvormil või muul tehniliselt ja funktsionaalselt samaväärsel ettevõttetaseme pilveplatvormil. 1.2.1.5 Samaväärse lahendusena võib pakkuda muu hulgas SAP SuccessFactors HCM-i, Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM-i või Workday HCM-i baasil loodud terviklahendust, sealhulgas koos Eesti õigusaktidele vastava palgaarvestusmooduli või integreeritud kolmanda isiku palgaarvestuslahendusega.
